svg.title: Choosing a Model by Capability
svg.desc: Step 1, match the input and output you need: write, summarise or chat uses a chat model, an LLM or SLM; image or audio input with text uses a multimodal model; semantic search and similarity use an embeddings model; creating a new image uses a GPT-image model; fixed-format results such as language or PII detection use Azure Language in Foundry Tools; a phone or edge device suits an SLM such as the Phi family. Step 2: filter the Foundry catalog of models sold by Azure and partner and community models, compare candidates on the leaderboards for quality, safety, cost and throughput, then try the shortlist with your own prompts using the playground compare feature. Picking the model with the most parameters or the cheapest per token is not a selection rule.
svg.text: Match input and output first; then compare candidates and test them with your own prompts.
